import numpy as np
from scipy.optimize import least_squares
var=np.var(dA_dt)
forms={
 "c0+c1 log t + c2 A^p t^q": (lambda p: p[0]+p[1]*np.log(t)+p[2]*A**p[3]*t**p[4], 5),
 "c0 t^p + c1 A^q t^r + c2 A^s": (lambda p: p[0]*t**p[1]+p[2]*A**p[3]*t**p[4]+p[5]*A**p[6], 7),
 "c0 log t + c1 A^p + c2 A^q log t": (lambda p: p[0]*np.log(t)+p[1]*A**p[2]+p[3]*A**p[4]*np.log(t), 5),
 "c0 exp(-p t) + c1 A^q t^r + c2 A^s t^u": (lambda p: p[0]*np.exp(-p[1]*t)+p[2]*A**p[3]*t**p[4]+p[5]*A**p[6]*t**p[7], 8),
 "c0 exp(-p A t) + c1 A^q log t + c2 ": (lambda p: p[0]*np.exp(-p[1]*A*t)+p[2]*A**p[3]*np.log(t)+p[4], 5),
}
rng=np.random.default_rng(0)
for name,(f,k) in forms.items():
    bestE=1e9;bp=None
    for trial in range(30):
        p0=rng.normal(0,1,k)
        try:
            r=least_squares(lambda p: f(p)-dA_dt, p0, max_nfev=3000)
            e=np.mean(r.fun**2)/var
            if e<bestE: bestE=e; bp=r.x
        except Exception as ex: pass
    print(name, bestE, np.round(bp,4))

 "t^p + A^q exp(-kt) + A^r t^s": (lambda p: p[0]*t**p[1]+p[2]*A**p[3]*np.exp(-p[4]*t)+p[5]*A**p[6]*t**p[7],8),
 "t^p + A^q t^s + A^r exp(-kt)": (lambda p: p[0]*t**p[1]+p[2]*A**p[3]*t**p[4]+p[5]*A**p[6]*np.exp(-p[7]*t),8),
 "c exp(-kt) + A^q t^s + A^r t^u": (lambda p: p[0]*np.exp(-p[1]*t)+p[2]*A**p[3]*t**p[4]+p[5]*A**p[6]*t**p[7],8),
 "t^p + A^q log t + A^r t^s": (lambda p: p[0]*t**p[1]+p[2]*A**p[3]*np.log(t)+p[4]*A**p[5]*t**p[6],7),
 "t^p + A^q + A^r t^s exp(-kt)": (lambda p: p[0]*t**p[1]+p[2]*A**p[3]+p[4]*A**p[5]*t**p[6]*np.exp(-p[7]*t),8),
}
